name: MoYu Super AoLong 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - 19th Anniversary Edition
description: The MoYu Super AoLong 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - 19th Anniversary Edition is MoYu's flagship celebration build, pairing a 20-magnet ball-core with one-button triple magnetic adjustment so you can retune the entire feel of the cube without ever taking it apart.
features: Deep tuning without disassembly: One-button triple adjustment retunes three magnetic forces at once, so you dial in the feel by hand instead of swapping parts.
Competition-level magnet count: A 100-magnet maximum configuration drives strong, stable magnetic alignment for accurate turning.
Lightweight flagship: At 72g, it stays fast and easy to control through long sessions.
One-button triple adjustment: A single adjustment simultaneously controls ball-core attraction, edge and corner attraction, and ball-core repulsion.
8-level ball-core attraction: Adjust the magnetic distance between the feet and ball core to control the strength of the core pull.
8-level edge & corner attraction: Tune the piece-to-piece magnetic distance for faster alignment.
